text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the quality of full grooms, puppy cuts, and deshedding treatments. Reviewers note that dogs leave the salon looking neat, smelling fresh, and feeling visibly lighter after their sessions. Clients commend the team for achieving breed-standard cuts and successfully trimming difficult claws on challenging breeds.

The salon team receives widespread praise for being friendly, communicative, and helpful from arrival to collection. Reviewers appreciate that groomers take time to discuss styling preferences and offer practical grooming advice for home maintenance between appointments. Pet parents value the five-star customer service and genuine enthusiasm.

Clients highlight the staff's ability to keep dogs happy, relaxed, and secure throughout their appointments. Reviewers share that nervous rescues or pets with previous negative salon experiences build confidence quickly, often running eagerly through the doors. Pet owners appreciate the patient handling given to senior, timid, or poorly dogs.

q.en: Does Freshpaws offer a pet collection and drop-off service?

a.en: Yes, the salon provides pet transport and collection services for clients across the Sutton Coldfield area.

q.en: How do groomers handle dogs that are anxious about claw clipping?

a.en: Reviewers note that staff take time to build trust and use gentle, patient methods to clip claws safely on nervous dogs.
The salon offers introductory puppy cuts and gentle styling sessions to help young dogs become accustomed to grooming.
